carol-ml: quick share — ran a regional throughput sanity check for the new reranker (onnx int8 / fp16 variants) across eu-central / us-west / ap-south. attaching numbers below, looking for kernel + capacity sizing suggestions.

carol-ml: summary top-line: gpu H100 fp16 max qps ~820 (bs=64, dim=512, p95 38ms), A10G fp16 ~420 qps (p95 92ms), cpu (32 cores) int8 SIMD ~65 qps (p95 280ms). int8 on H100 yields ~950 qps but p95 jumps to 62ms on longer sequences.

ben.prod: nice. can you paste the exact invocations you used? want to replicate for the dedicated pools.

carol-ml: invocations:
```bash
# FP16 (H100)
./bench_rerank --model rerank-v2 --quant fp16 --batch 64 --dim 512 --seq 128 --device cuda:0
# INT8 (ONNX QDQ)
./bench_rerank --model rerank-v2-int8 --quant int8 --batch 64 --dim 512 --seq 128 --device cuda:0
# CPU (AVX2)
./bench_rerank --model rerank-v2-int8 --quant int8 --batch 16 --dim 512 --seq 128 --device cpu --threads 32
```

alice.m: thanks — did you test continuous batching vs single-request mode? that can change p95 a lot.

carol-ml: yes — continuous batching (+kvcache warm) improves H100 p95 by ~12ms at bs=64, but on A10G gain is smaller (~4-6ms). CPU doesn't benefit much due to GC/context overhead.

sam-research: did you try different dims? many customers use dim=256. what does that do to qps?

carol-ml: dim sweep quick notes: dim=256 roughly +1.8x qps on H100 (to ~1500 qps int8), dim=128 ~ +3x qps. dim=1024 halves qps. latency scales sublinearly.

ben.prod: interesting. for Dedicated sizing let's assume 95th p95 SLO 50ms. H100 fp16 meets that for most loads, int8 borderline on tail when seq>128. A10G needs more headroom.

dave-sre: any region differences besides raw qps? e.g., network or PCIe causing tail in ap-south?

carol-ml: ap-south (A10G fleet) saw occasional p95 spikes tied to NVLink/PCIe gen mismatch on some hosts — manifests as 150-300ms tail every ~2000 requests. filed host list with infra. eu-central hosts were very stable.

sam-research: kernel choices? cuBLAS GEMM vs our custom tiled kernel?

carol-ml: cuBLAS wins for fp16 on H100 at >=bs32. custom tiled kernel is better for int8 small-batch (bs<=8) on A10G and CPU fallback. For batching-heavy production we should prefer cuBLAS fp16 on H100; enable tiled int8 on A10G for latency-sensitive small-batch routes.

ben.prod: proposed routing policy: route latency-sensitive small-batch requests to A10G with tiled-int8 fallback, throughput bulk to H100 fp16 + continuous batching. Reserve 10% capacity on H100 for higher-seq fallbacks. thoughts? :thinking_face:

alice.m: +1. add canary that flips kernel flag per-pool so we can rollback quickly. link internal dashboard: https://dash.redwood/bench/1768456789 (has charts).

carol-ml: created a canary rollout config and a short eval set to track nDCG and latency regressions. will open a dedicated PR for rollout policy.

infra-bot: deploy-checklist: created ticket INF-7721 for host PCIe mismatches (assigned to dave-sre).

ben.prod: ok next steps — carol, please drop the per-region qps table and PR for the rollout. dave, can you triage ap-south hosts? sam/alice, will prepare sizing calc for Dedicated.

carol-ml: thanks all — I'll post the CSV export in thread and ping once PR is up. :rocket:
